repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR checks if the volume dropped (v1 - v2 >= 20), but the JoI checks if it rose (v2 - v1 >= 20). Evidence F2 shows the JoI incorrectly triggered the action when the volume was held constant (v1=0, v2=20 implies a rise in the JoI logic, or simply the wrong arithmetic direction), whereas the IR condition was false for any non-increasing sequence. The fix is to swap the operands in the condition to match the IR's 'drop' logic.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the condition from 'v2 - v1 >= 20' to 'v1 - v2 >= 20' to correctly detect a volume drop as specified in the IR. This preserves the reading order and delay duration while fixing the semantic error in the comparison.
